snv.title: snv
snv.description: Run small variant calling using Clair3.

sv.title: sv
sv.description: Run somatic structural variant calling using severus.

mod.title: mod
mod.description: Run modified base aggregation using modkit and differential modification computation using DSS.

sample_name.title: sample_name
sample_name.description: The sample name will be used from the workflow to correctly name output files.

bam_normal.title: bam_normal
bam_normal.description: Either (i) path to a single BAM file or (ii) directory containing BAM files.

bam_tumor.title: bam_tumor
bam_tumor.description: Either (i) path to a single BAM file or (ii) directory containing BAM files.

ref.title: Reference Genome
ref.description: Path to a reference FASTA file for variant calling.

bed.title: bed
bed.description: An optional BED file enumerating regions to process for variant calling.

tr_bed.title: tr_bed
tr_bed.description: An optional BED file enumerating simple repeat regions in genome of choice. The bed file must follow UCSC specification.

annotation.title: SnpEff annotation
annotation.description: If this option is deselected, VCFs will not be annotated with SnpEff.

include_all_ctgs.title: include_all_ctgs
include_all_ctgs.description: Call for variants on all sequences in the reference, otherwise small variants will only be called on chr{1..22,X,Y,MT}. Typically not required.

depth_intervals.title: Output a bedGraph file with entries for each genomic interval featuring homogeneous depth.
depth_intervals.description: The output bedGraph file will have an entry for each genomic interval in which all positions have the same alignment depth. By default this workflow outputs summary depth information from your aligned reads. Per-base depth outputs are slower to generate but may be required for some downstream applications.

tumor_min_coverage.title: tumor_min_coverage
tumor_min_coverage.description: A tumor BAM below this coverage threshold will not be processed in downstream analyses. Set to 0 to skip check and proceed directly to downstream analyses.

normal_min_coverage.title: normal_min_coverage
normal_min_coverage.description: A normal BAM below this coverage threshold will not be processed in downstream analyses. Set to 0 to skip check and proceed directly to downstream analyses.

hybrid_mode_vcf.title: hybrid_mode_vcf
hybrid_mode_vcf.description: Enable hybrid calling mode that combines the *de novo* calling results and genotyping results at the positions in the VCF file given.

genotyping_mode_vcf.title: genotyping_mode_vcf
genotyping_mode_vcf.description: VCF file input containing candidate sites to be genotyped. Variants will only be called at the sites in the VCF file if provided.

normal_vcf.title: normal_vcf
normal_vcf.description: VCF file input containing normal sites for the given sample. Pointing to a pre-computed normal VCF file will prevent the workflow from calling the germline sites for the normal sample, reducing processing time.

skip_haplotype_filter.title: skip_haplotype_filter
skip_haplotype_filter.description: Setting this will skip haplotype filtering of variants.

fast_mode.title: fast_mode
fast_mode.description: Setting this will speed up the germline calling from Clair3 by relaxing the variant calling parameters; this matches ClairS default behaviour, and therefore will not emit germline VCFs.

germline.title: germline
germline.description: The workflow will perform germline calling and tumor phasing as default; set to false to disable this (greatly speeds up execution).

phase_normal.title: phase_normal
phase_normal.description: Phase and tag the normal, in addition to the tumor dataset.

liquid_tumor.title: liquid_tumor
liquid_tumor.description: Setting this to true will have ClairS to use specific presets and model (where available) for liquid tumors, increasing accuracy.

min_sv_length.title: min_sv_length
min_sv_length.description: Provide the minimum size of the structural variants to call with severus.

force_strand.title: Require modkit to call strand-aware modifications.

diff_mod.title: Detect differentially modified loci and regions with DSS.

override_basecaller_cfg.title: Name of the model to use for converting signal and selecting a small variant calling model.
override_basecaller_cfg.description: The workflow will attempt to find the basecaller model from the headers of your input data, providing a value for this option will override the model found in the data. If the model cannot be found in the header, it must be provided with this option as the basecaller model is required for small variant calling. The basecaller model is used to automatically select the appropriate small variant calling model. The model list shows all models that are compatible for small variant calling with this workflow. You should select 'custom' to override the basecaller_cfg with clair3_model_path.

ubam_map_threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for aligning reads from uBAM (limited by config executor cpus).

ubam_sort_threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for sorting and indexing aligned reads from uBAM (limited by config executor cpus).

ubam_bam2fq_threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for uncompressing uBAM and generating FASTQ for alignment (limited by config executor cpus).

severus_threads.description: Total number of threads to use for Severus (minimum of 4 and limited by config executor cpus).

dss_threads.description: Total number of threads to use in the DSS differential modification analysis (limited by config executor cpus).

modkit_threads.description: Total number of threads to use in modkit modified base calling (limited by config executor cpus).

haplotype_filter_threads.description: Set max number of threads to use for the haplotype filtering stage in SNV workflow (limited by config executor cpus).
